name: Himuro Yutaka
source:
Recurring character.

A middle-aged detective who belongs to the First Division of the Prefectural Police. He used to be Narumi Seiji's junior when the latter was a police detective, and because of that connection, he easily agrees to cooperate with [url=/c123785]Kyouka[/url] and [url=/c123784]Kyousuke[/url]. He has an aloof and elusive personality, but he also has a cunning side thanks to which he deliberately ignores police rules in order to solve some cases.

[Translated from [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/MISSING_PARTS_the_TANTEI_STORIES]Wikipedia[/url].]
